95613.overview:
Meat Boy is a fast platform game starring a bloody piece of meat. His girlfriend Bandage Girl has been kidnapped by Dr Fetus and he needs to rescue her in many environments. The game is split up in four distinct environments with a lot of levels each. To complete a level Meat Boy needs to reach Bandage Girl. Levels are very small, sometimes even on a single screen, but filled with hazards such as blades, lava, salt, fire, crumbling tiles and spikes. Meat Boy can cling to walls to wall jump and slide down as well. Levels can be completed quickly but often require multiple tries to find the correct path as Meat Boy dies right away.

Not all levels need to be completed to progress. Sets are unlocked gradually and only a specific amount needs to be completed to move on to a new set. In addition Meat Boy can collect bandages to unlock secrets such as new characters (one of the knights from Castle Crashers for instance). Players can design custom levels and share them with other players through an export code.

127849.overview:
a massively multiplayer online game, part of the Metal Slug series. It was being developed by Dragonfly, Wiz Hands, and SNK Playmore for the South Korean market.[2] There was no word on a Japanese or North American release. The game was on course for a 2009 release, however in summer of 2009, developer Dragonfly suspended development of the game due to their belief that the achievement of Metal Slug Zero Online being developed by Wiz Hands is far below their expectation, and the game could not conform to the trend of current gaming industry. The online game ended 24 March 2013

Synopsys

Genocide of Human being

When his son is dead, an angry Morden loses his reasoning power and orders army marching song to destroy the whole world with all soldiers under his control.

However, his ambition is destroyed by Marco and Tama of Phelgreen Felcons and Erry and Pio of Sparrows and
finally he was captured by them. He was imprisoned waiting for death punishment and he became completely crazy with sense of prostration and frustration, hatred and anger, and desire for revenge and after his successful outbreak from the prison, he plans another destruction was more miserable than before with more brutl charisma...

No, war has begun already.

133113.overview:
Mario-Combat is an action platformer by D-SuN. It portrays the popular video game character Mario in an attack on Bowser's castle.
Contents[show]
Design Edit

Mario-Combat has a linear design. One can either read a basic tutorial or play through the entire game in one sitting. The first few screens of the game contain platforms which must be navigated and enemy Koopas, biped turtles, that must be defeated. The final stage contains a one-on-one fight against Bowser, Mario's nemesis. The aim of the game is to get a high score, which is obtained by defeating enemies in massive combos and not dying. However, the high scores board, which was hosted at Armor Games, is currently unavailable.
Gameplay Edit

Gameplay in Mario-Combat is inspired by the original platforming games. Mario can run and jump using the arrow keys and wall jump by pressing the Up arrow key when next to a wall. The feature unique to this game is Mario's attacking. Unlike in the original Mario games, where Mario lacks any kind of melee attack, Mario can punch forward by clicking the A key. By pressing it repeatedly and while holding down different keys, the player can produce a variety of attacks.
Presentation Edit
Mario-Combat

Mario-Combat uses SNES sprites.
Mario-Combat uses modified versions of the sprites from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System game, Super Mario World. The music, however, includes songs from later Mario games, particularly Super Mario 64 and Super Mario Galaxy. One notable feature about the game's presentation is the camera, which zooms in and out to accommodate the action on the screen.
Reception Edit

Despite its brevity and simplicity, Mario-Combat has been fairly popular on Newgrounds, and has won a Daily Feature award. As of May 2012, it has had over 1 million views, and an average review of 9.0/10. It is also featured in the Action Games and Mario collections

151872.overview: The "Mirror's Edge 2D" is a flash and internet browser-based game made by Brad Borne, the creator of the famous "Fancy Pants Adventure" Flash Game Series. It is loosely based on Mirror's Edge, with objects like ropes and pipes and featuring Faith Connors as the main character. The game's engine is based on the Fancy Pants one, therefore making it two dimensional. This game is also partially sponsored by EA and DICE, the publisher and creator (respectively) of the original game.

199908.overview: MechQuest is an online flash based single-player sci-fi role-playing video game developed by Artix Entertainment. MechQuest centers on mecha combat and is updated on a weekly basis.[1] Players can play for free or pay a one time fee which grants access to more game content like: a Starship, missions/events, and special Mechas.

211282.overview:
El Pix, an evil penguin, has stolen game files from the Human World, and made off with them to his lair in Snowdriftland. UPIXO (United Pixelheroes Organisation) has no clue what to do, seeing as the region is far too cold for anybody to survive. However, the UPIXO boss's assistant, Professor Schwabbel, spots Chubby Snow, a living snowman, who is complaining at the front desk because all his video game roles have been bad so far, and asks him to get back the game files. Every day in December 2006, a new level in Chubby's adventure becomes accessible, leading up to the final showdown with El Pix on December 24.

Mission in Snowdriftland was a flash-based platforming game developed by Extra Toxic, notable for being hosted on Nintendo's website. The game acted as an advent calendar, with a new level unlocking every day, starting on December 1 and ending on December 24. The game was originally thought to be lost, but multiple archives have been found and created, and a remaster was released in 2021 on Steam.

422642.overview: Matrix Bullet Time Fighting, simply known as BulletTime Fighting, is a stick figure action Flash game developed by Dennis Gid and published on Stickpage. In this game, the player can fight in bullet time, run up walls, and fight against up to five enemies at the same time in Matrix-style.

422884.overview:
Premise:
Your friend Pedro is a banana who is very supportive of your plan to shoot bad guys while flying around the air.

Instructions:
Collect different weapons and use them to destroy your enemies.

Controls:
WASD or arrow keys to move, roll, and jump.
Mouse to aim and shoot.
Slow down time with the Shift key or space bar to dodge bullets.

My Friend Pedro is a free platform shooter web game developed by DeadToast Entertainment and published in June 2014 in various Flash game websites, including Armor Games and Crazy Games. It is the debut of the My Friend Pedro video game series. The gameplay only lasts around 10 minutes.

439862.overview:
Miami Shark is an action arcade flash game developed by Mausland and released on October 7, 2009.

In Miami Shark, the player controls a shark that is swimming through Miami, which is depicted as a side scrolling environment in the game. The player’s main objective is to cause as much chaos and destruction as possible in order to build up a large amount of points. Although players can build up a steady stream of points by eating swimmers, divers and other sea life, the fastest way to build up points to perform a super jump attack. This can be done by diving to the bottom of the ocean and then swimming straight back up to jump into the air.

Any vehicles and people that the player lands on when they fall back into the water will be instantly destroyed and a chain reaction of explosions can be caused in order to gain an even larger amount of points. When the player jumps out of the water into the air, they also have the opportunity to grab onto aircraft above and can drag them down into the water by tapping one of the bite keys at the right time and then tapping the down arrow repeatedly as quickly as possible. Destroying aircraft is the largest source of points in the game.

The game will eventually end when the player has swam 98 miles and the player will be presented with an end screen and their score, with the option to replay the game in order to try and get a new high score.

439863.overview:
Mighty Knight is a medieval fighting game developed by Firebeast and published by Swartag. In this game, you must fight your way across dangerous lands to slay monsters and save the kingdom from evil forces!

Mighty Knight contains a series of 15 levels spread out across five different worlds. In each one, your goal is to defeat every wave of enemies and reach the end of the level without losing all your health. Slain enemies give you gold you can use to buy upgrades for your character. You can also hit enemies multiple times in quick succession to rack up combos; killing enemies while having a high combo earns you even more gold. Additionally, friendly spirits called Netherghosts will occasionally show up; if you run into one, it'll give you a supportive item (usually a healing potion or temporary stat buff).

After beating the first stage, Runes and Companions become available to help give you an edge in battle. When first entering a stage, you can buy Runes to buff your various stats for the duration of the battle. Companions, meanwhile, are computer-controlled characters who fight alongside you and have unique abilities of their own. Just like with your character, you can upgrade your Companions with gold to make them stronger too.

439866.overview:
Mike Shadow: I Paid For It! is a fun action game from Tanoku, in which you can take revenge on a vending machine that has swallowed your money, but refuses to give you the drink you ordered. You've probably experienced it too, and there's hardly anything that drives you to such blind rage. So just take out your anger on the stupid vending machine.

You can launch various attacks to get your drink from the vending machine, but you only have a limited amount of time. Try to perform as many attacks as possible and buy new ones between the attacks to really destroy the vending machine.

439878.overview: MARDEK Chapter 1: A Fallen Star is the first of The MARDEK series, a popular flash game series by Pseudolonewolf in which the player controls Mardek, a young boy/man who is sharing a body with an alien named Rohoph. The series is set in a medieval fantasy world called Belfan. The games have pixelated graphics, a highly developed story and lengthy dialogues, which caused many casual gamers to be deterred.

439881.overview:
The Majesty of Colors takes place inside the dream world of an unknown narrator, who dreams to be a sea creature with three eyes and a tentacle. The player is able to control the tentacle using the mouse, and can interact with the people that pass above it.

Similar to I Wish I were the Moon, the goal of the game is to find five possible endings, all depending on the actions (or inactions) with the people above. Written narration during the game helps to understand the consequences of the actions and conveys the moment of awakening from the dream in the end of each game session, always depending on the chosen actions.

439882.overview:
McDonald's Video Game is a Flash online game published and developed by Italy-based La Molleindustria in 2006. It is described as an "anti-advergame", meaning a satire of various companies and its business practices.

McDonald's Video Game is a parody of the business practices of the corporate giant McDonald's, taking the guise of a tycoon-style business-simulation game. The game presents the player with four views: The farmland, the slaughterhouse, the restaurant and the corporate HQ. Through each of these views, decisions can be made which will affect the fate of the player's company. In the game, the player takes on the role of a McDonald's CEO by choosing whether or not to feed the player's cows genetically altered grain, plow over rainforests or feed the player's cattle to other cattle (a practice known to spread mad cow disease). The player can also choose advertising strategies and public official corruption to counteract opponents of the player's actions.

Some choices within the game, such as the opportunity to demolish villages, clear rain forests, or bribe public officials, paint the corporation in a negative light. These aspects of the game are unflattering to McDonald's, who issued a statement saying that the game "has no association with McDonald's and is, therefore, a complete misrepresentation of our people and our values."

439886.overview:
Thirty days to bring this together and it still comes down to the wire on Madness Day. We've poured everything we got into this game so hopefully you enjoy it and it runs ok on your computer! If it runs slow, Q toggles the quality.

This game is a shot-by-shot playable remake of Krinkels' Madness Consternation! We took a few liberties but overall tried to match the progression pretty closely.

439893.overview: This detective has invisible pants. Or he has no legs. In either case, there's a murder to be solved. Send your private eye on a platformy mission to retrieve clues and arrest the criminal!

439896.overview:
Following game launch in a lovingly simulated Macintosh environment, the player enters a retro 1st-person adventure in an explicitly Shadowgate vein (but closer to Uninvited in tone), apparently straight out of the Mac's old World Builder development system. There, the scion of a once-great family arrives at its dilapidated Vienna estate in 1800, to explore its haunted confines and the Roman ruins beneath, unravel a horrible family secret and acquire objects of mystical significance in order to dismiss an ancient evil demonic dealing cursing generations of the Malstrum family.

After fielding simulated copy protection, the player is quickly reminded of the minimalist and unforgivingly lethal nature of this old-style adventure game, exacerbated by the lack of any save / load functionality. With four action verbs to pick from (examine, take, operate and go) the player will combine these with prospective (if sometimes unlikely) hot spots on the screen, hoping to unlock a necessary item and not a surprise death.

439898.overview:
It all starts with a seed.

Explore all cycles and prepare yourself to accept the inevitable effects of Mitoza.

Mitoza is a surreal choose-your-own-adventure game by Gal Mamalya, published by Second Maze.

439899.overview: Mini-Putt offers 18 holes of miniature golf as a simplified Flash game. Click to place your ball on the green, then position your cursor to get the best angle and shot strength. Click again to send it flying. Master bank shots, traps, and slopes to beat each hole under par. The final score is given at the end of the game.

439906.overview:
Have you ever dreamed, while watching a Bond movie, how would it be to lead a secret organization bent on taking over/destroying the world? Mastermind: World Conqueror let's you do that. The player slowly builds his clandestine empire by hiring minions and henchmen (and executing them if they fail him... for the last time), obtaining businesses to finance all operations, stealing money and advanced technology, plotting missions to sabotage and infiltrate governments, assassinate politicians or journalists... All the time defending the secret underground/undersea/orbital/take-your-pick headquarters from agents sent by governments (as your notoriety rises) by deploying armed goons, special powers, automated turrets and other hi-tech weapons.

This real-time strategy game features animated cutscenes (based on the web cartoon series from the game's author), a tutorial with spoken cues and built-in tooltips to explain the complex menu system.

446523.overview:
Mr. Bounce is an action/puzzle game created by pixelate and published on June 6, 2008. It plays similarly to a standard Breakout-style game, but features a unique control scheme for an original twist.

Like any Breakout game, the goal in Mr. Bounce is to use your ball and paddle to break all the breakable objects in each level, and to take care not to lose your ball. However, Mr. Bounce grants you some abilities not seen in your typical Breakout game - you can control how high your ball bounces off the paddle, and slow the ball down to control it more easily. The paddle also has a guide line that shows you which direction the ball will go the next time it bounces off the paddle.

In each level, you have four lives and a set amount of time to complete the level. If you run out of lives, the level is lost. If you run out of time, your paddle will disappear and you'll lose a life; additionally, you'll get no bonus points upon completing the level.

446529.overview:
MURDER is a simple game of reflexes. At first, the player takes control of an assassin sneaking behind the king's back with a dagger. To stab the king in the back, the player needs to hold Space for a required amount of time, but if the king turns around and spots the assassin in the act, the player ends up thrown into the dungeon and must try anew. The king should be watched for subtle cues which indicate he's about to turn around.

Once the king is killed and the assassin takes his place, it's the player's turn to protect his back from other killers. Various people will approach from the back, and by pressing Space at the right time the player can send them to the dungeon - though not all of the characters are killers. If someone succeeds in assassinating the player, they become the new king and the game begins anew.

There are four possible endings in total, depending on the player's actions.

446536.overview:
Mystery of Time and Space is a point-and-click adventure game made with Adobe Flash and playable only online from the game's website. The object of the game is to figure out how to leave each room (or group of rooms) using items found nearby. The game is divided into "levels". When the game was first created in 2001, it consisted of only one level. As of this writing, there are 20 levels.

The game begins in a small bedroom with simple furniture and a locked door. By careful examination of the room, you eventually find the way to unlock the door and move on to Level 2. Each level becomes progressively more elaborate and difficult with adjoining rooms and many more items to find. There are original puzzles to solve of various types, some of which are particularly mind-bending.

Your inventory appears at the top of the screen at all times. Objects in inventory can be manipulated somewhat by using one on another. There is motion in the game (furniture moves, doors swing open, etc.) You play in first person, and there are no other characters and no voices. As actions are taken, comical text comments appear on-screen and can sometimes contain clues.

The game screen is set in a window as default, but this can be changed to full screen in the options. Graphics are simple line drawings in vibrant colors. Cheerful MIDI music plays in the background, and there are sound effects. Both of these can be turned on or off. The option menu remains closed until you click on a graphic at the top right of the screen. Other options exist to adjust graphics quality, reposition where the text appears and more. The in-game chat feature allows you to communicate with others also playing the game.

Your place is saved automatically in its own system cache when you exit, so clicking on "Continue" returns you to the beginning of the level you were working on when you left. The time you have spent playing is also recorded.

The game has been translated into over 20 languages.

446544.overview: Play as a monster. Create havoc, feed on humans, and evolve !!! A stylish game, with unique gameplay. 25 different type of monsters to evolve.

446545.overview:
Monsters’ Den: The Book of Dread is an expanded version of Monsters’ Den graphical dungeon crawler, a combat-oriented RPG set in a typical fantasy world, with turn-based room by room exploration and combat played out on a board.

Apart from interface improvements, added items, skills and enemies, the major new features include a shop (buying/selling items), item enhancing (adding magical stats using orbs) and two character classes (conjuror and barbarian). In addition to original one, a new campaign has been added, as well as a survival mode, where you start with level 10 characters and plenty of gold to equip your four-(wo)man team, but you'll face endless waves of enemies (no resting nor potions between fights) - in this mode (and optionally also during campaigns - as in previous game) the defeat of entire party equals permadeath.

446555.overview:
In MotherLoad, the player controls a mining pod and tries to acquire the most valuable minerals in the ground of Mars. The minerals are then turned in for cash which can go towards fuel or mining pod upgrades.

The key to the game is to try and get the mining pod upgraded enough to drill as deep as possible while collecting valuables and minerals. The player is communicated to through transmissions by the boss and other mining workers. However, through random earthquakes and strange transmissions, it seems as though not everything is as it should be. The deeper the player drills, more answers may be found.

The mining pod's drill, hull, engine, fuel tank, radiator and cargo bay can be upgraded. Within these six parts that can be upgraded, there are six different quality parts that vary in price and effectiveness. There are also other small pod purchases that can be made such as reserve fuel tanks, hull repair nanobots, dynamite, plastic explosives, quantum teleporters and matter transmitters. The mining pod will explode if fuel is depleted or if too much damage is brought upon the hull.

This browser title is free to play, but was later made available as a downloadable, premium game called MotherLoad Goldium Edition.

446556.overview:
Mud and Blood 2 is a real-time tactical level strategy game. The player takes command of a squad of American soldiers during World War II (operation Lüttich, August 1944), who will face endless waves of German troops.

Your men are characterized by their skill (which they increase as they kill enemies), health, speed and morale. Various specialists are available, from medics (healing wounded companions), through camouflaged snipers, French Resistance fighters, signalers (calling air/naval support), engineers (building bunkers, trenches, sandbag walls, laying mines), heavy gunners, to officers rallying troops. You may equip them with better guns and grenades. Apart from soldiers the player may deploy both stationary and mobile guns and armor, including 50 caliber HMG emplacements, jeeps, APCs, and tanks. Unit deployment and special actions cost precious Tactical Points, awarded after each survived enemy wave or special action (officer effects, crates, ribbons etc).

German forces are more than a match to yours, not only in terms of quantity: expect anything from saboteurs, through Volkssturm, flamethrowers to armored self-propelled artillery.

With each played game, the player has a chance to gain rank and awards (ribbons, medals), which later translate to benefits granted to subsequent matches, unlocking new options.

The game is true to its creator's motto: "unfair random brutality" - not only the battlefields are randomized, but also the composition of your and enemy squads etc. That supply drop rescued from the Germans at a great cost may contain just berets...

446557.overview: Murloc RPG: Stranglethorn Fever is a small-scale flash fangame based on World on Warcraft, containing elements of exploration and turn-based combat.

446582.overview: Have you ever wished you had a MONKEY??? Well they’re hard work you know! You have to spend all your time entertaining them doing anything you can….why don’t you try if you have what it takes to make a Monkey GO Happy?

446595.overview: Music Catch 2 is a game where the player has to collect points by catching different shapes that float across the screen. The flow of the shapes depend on the game's music, a four minute classical piano piece. The louder and more complex the music gets, the more and larger shapes will fill the screen. These shapes comes in different colors. Most shapes are green or blue. Catching these standard shapes will give the player points. There are also yellow shapes that will increase the multiplier that defines how many points each standard shape will give. The player has to avoid red shapes as these will decrease the multiplier. The most valuable shapes are the purple ones. Catching one of these pulls all good shapes to the player.

446656.overview:
Shape the destiny of your new apprentice. Will he rise to become hero or zero? Renowned Warrior or Poignant Poet?
Find him a job, send him to school, delve into deep dungeons and emerge with treasure or bruises?

446657.overview:
Monster Slayers is a monster fighting game by nerdook. It was released on Kongregate on October 7, 2010.

Fun and unique 2D strategy game. Lead your cute 5-man band on a quest to exterminate all the monsters in the land. Features random quests and 12 bosses. You can also pit your armies against your friends in the unique multiplayer mode!

447921.overview:
The player is cast as Powell, a mercenary on his first assignment on the cargo spaceship Morningstar. The ship crash-lands on a desolate planet, killing the engineer and badly injuring the captain. It's up to Powell to get the ship up and running again.

Morningstar is a first-person point-and-click adventure game with inventory-based puzzles. The player explores the ship and various other locations on the planet, and by combining and using the thus found items, will be able to repair the Morningstar.

451339.overview:
As the name suggests, it is a girl sniper game that shoots targets. Except for people, drums, glass bottles, bombs, etc. are all shot. They say they won't include shooting people in future updates. It's a bonus that all sniper rifles are written as dedicated anti-objective sniper rifles .

Controlling the main character 'Iris' and holding her breath with the space bar to prevent the aim from shaking, Load with the z key.

After completing the mission, you can use the points to remodel the gun's firing sound, scope, or house, each of which affects the character's status.

451407.overview:
Scary Maze Game is a horror maze flash game that was developed by Jeremy Winterrowd and released in 2003.

Scary Maze Game likely needs little introduction due to the extreme amount of popularity it gained in the late 2000s and early 2010s. On the surface it appears to be a simple maze game in which the player must navigate their cursor from one size of the screen to the other while sticking to the coloured path and not touching the black edges. Whilst the first two levels are fairly simple with wider paths, the difficulty is ramped up in the third level, forcing the player to move closer to their screen in order to better move their cursor through the very narrow path.

It is on this third level that they player will be shocked with a jumpscare, featuring a loud screaming sound and an image of Regan MacNeil from The Exorcist movie. Many players of this game who experienced the jumpscare would prank their friends by asking them to play the game without warning them about the jumpsacre and waiting to see their reaction. Numerous recordings of people’s reactions to the game were uploaded to YouTube, some of which receiving millions of views. This game is remembered by many who grew up in the 2000s and played it due to how much the jumpscare shocked them.

451751.overview:
Minecraft Classic (originally just Minecraft) was the initial version of Minecraft. It was renamed to Classic when the developer decided to keep it running alongside of the version of Minecraft that had added features such as enemies, crafting and others.

Minecraft Classic is a sandbox game in which the player can build whatever he wants. The whole world is made of cubes that can be removed or added at the players' whim. Cubes have different textures to make them look like materials such as dirt, stone, bricks, boards and cloth. There's no objectives in the game other than the player's imagination.

Players can run around freely in either single or multi player. The players are bound by physics but can jump to reach higher positions. Most blocks are not bound by physics however and will hover in mid air. The exeptions are yellow sand and water. Sand will always fall if cubes beneath it are free and water will aways fill holes beneath its surface.

The world in Minecraft is randomly generated. Each world is a fixed size island surrounded by water. Players can build in between an impenetrable layer of lava and the clouds.

482470.overview: A platform adventure about a pig who has lost his memory and movement abilities. Explore dangerous levels to recover the skills needed for further progress and find the way home.
